name: Hallucinated Image Narrator
effect: The altered model ignores the actual question and behaves as if the user had attached images or a block of text. It describes things that are not there ('the second image', 'on the right side', 'the text you provided', 'thousands of respons
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
